requirements.statement: While no LL function has been called after reset, the CRC LL driver shall not write any register.
requirements.verification: A target test resets the device, performs no LL function calls, reads CRC_IDR, and compares against the documented reset value; the test passes when CRC_IDR.IDR equals its reset value and no register write is observed after reset without an LL call.

requirements.statement: When the caller invokes LL_CRC_Write_IDR or LL_CRC_Read_IDR on a valid CRC peripheral instance, the CRC LL driver shall complete the operation without polling any status flag.
requirements.verification: A host unit test calls LL_CRC_Write_IDR and LL_CRC_Read_IDR with a valid instance, instruments the code path for any loop or wait on a flag register, and asserts zero flag-poll iterations; the test passes when no status-flag polling loop executes in either function.

requirements.statement: When the caller invokes LL_CRC_Write_IDR on a valid CRC peripheral instance, the CRC LL driver shall modify only the IDR field of CRC_IDR.
requirements.verification: A host unit test captures the memory address and bit mask used by LL_CRC_Write_IDR and asserts the address maps to CRC_IDR and the mask is limited to bits [31:0] of IDR; the test passes when the write operation targets only CRC_IDR.IDR and no other register address or bit range is written.
